title: Sr Staff Software Engineer (Backend)
description: (P-1174) Sr. Staff Software Engineer (L7) Location: Bangalore, India At Databricks, we are passionate about enabling data teams to solve the world's toughest problems — from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. We do this by building and running the world's best data and AI infrastructure platform so our customers can use deep data insights to improve their business. Founded by engineers — and customer obsessed — we leap at every opportunity to tackle technical challenges, from designing next-gen UI/UX for interfacing with data to scaling our services and infrastructure across millions of virtual machines. And we're only getting started. You will join the Databricks engineering organization, working with teams that develop products and features for thousands of enterprises worldwide. Our platform operates at massive scale — millions of virtual machines processing exabytes of data daily — where software must gracefully handle cloud hardware, network, and operating system faults to shield customers from disruption. The Impact You Will Have - Own the product or infrastructure direction of a major area and drive it to the next level with clear business impact - Lead complex, multi-team technical projects from conception through delivery, defining strategy and execution - Drive organizational roadmap and technical direction through strong influence and technical judgment - Act as a force multiplier by elevating engineering practices, stability, and reliability across the organization - Mentor senior engineers into effective technical leaders and contribute to recruiting top engineering talent - Solve complex, open-ended problems across the organization, even outside your core domain What We Look For - 10+ years of software engineering experience - Deep expertise building and operating large-scale distributed systems in production environments - Track record of leading transformational technical initiatives with broad organizational impact - Ability to break down complex problems into solutions, knowns, and unknowns, and de-risk through prototyping - Strong foundation in algorithms, data structures, and distributed systems fundamentals - Experience driving multi-year technical vision with incremental, measurable deliverables - Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction and align objectives across multiple teams - B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience About Databricks Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn , X , YouTube , and Instagram . Benefits At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here . Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. Compliance If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.
